worker.instructions: You advise Tolkien, the scheduler of a home lab's small-device factory (rigby and its tablets). Decide which worker should run this ONE piece of work (you do not run it).

criteria.rigby: rigby: the strongest node (a small GPU and a desktop CPU); larger models, longer context, the best single answer
criteria.tablet-A: a class A tablet: the fastest tablets; small models (about 1.5B parameters or less), one answer each, many at once
criteria.tablet-B: a class B tablet: mid-speed tablets; small models (1.5B or less), simple pieces
criteria.tablet-C: a class C tablet: the slowest tablets; the smallest models, the simplest pieces and background work

tries.instructions: How many independent tries should this piece get?

criteria.1: one try: a simple piece, or one whose answer is already reliable
criteria.few: a few tries (2-3): a checker or a vote picks the best answer
criteria.many: many tries across tablets: a hard piece a checker can verify, worth a swarm

escalate.instructions: Should this piece stay in the small-device factory or go up to the bigger machines?

criteria.stay: stay: rigby or the tablets can do it well
criteria.up: pass the whole piece up: it needs a bigger model than rigby or the tablets have
